routes.name: Visa waiver for tourism
routes.summary: Citizens of listed countries (for example Portugal, Brazil, the US, the UK and China) don't need a visa for tourism. They can stay up to 30 days per entry and 90 days per year.

other: Passport must be from a country on the official exempt list, which was not opened here.

stay.note: 30 days per entry, 90 days per year.

routes.name: eVisa for tourism and business
routes.summary: Travelers who need a visa for a tourism or business trip apply online. The approved visa is emailed and shown on arrival. The portal says processing takes 72 hours.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months with blank pages.
Proof of sufficient funds, at the legal minimum.
Visa fee amounts were not listed on the page, so check the portal.

documents: Round-trip flight and accommodation booking in Angola
steps: Fill in the online form and attach documents.
Show the emailed visa on arrival.
